SELECT
  to_char(date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  ABS(SUM(p.payment_value)) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE
  o.order_purchase_timestamp >= (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', MAX(o2.order_purchase_timestamp)) - INTERVAL '11 months' FROM orders o2
  )
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', MAX(o2.order_purchase_timestamp)) + INTERVAL '1 month' FROM orders o2
  )
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY month ASC;
